access.description: Prisma Postgres credentials always have full access to the database. Read-only runs every statement in a read-only transaction, so agents cannot change data or schema.
access.label: Access

host.description: Use the direct connection unless your plan's direct connection limit is reached.
host.label: Connection

username.description: The part of your connection string between postgres:// and the first colon.
username.label: Username

password.description: The part of your connection string between the colon after the username and @db.prisma.io.
password.label: Password
